messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: cross-region routing error — high error rate from EU->APAC paths; customers seeing 5xx spikes, threshold breached (p95 latency > 2s). TL;DR: suspected routing policy mis-evaluation. Investigate now.
Alice SRE: I’m on it. pulling telemetry for EU region. anyone seeing similar in US? @Eli are you available to standby for handoff.
Eli Oncall: here. just grabbed the pager. ping me when you have a summary.
Raj Network: seeing abnormal steering signals from control plane at 17:34 UTC — weight changes flipping for apac-east region. looks like policy evaluation loop. attaching quick grep from route-logs:
```
2026-03-15T17:34:12Z policy-eval id=abc123 weights_before={eu:0.9,apac:0.1} weights_after={eu:0.3,apac:0.7} reason=latency-feedback
2026-03-15T17:34:20Z policy-eval id=abc123 weights_after={eu:0.95,apac:0.05} reason=telemetry-spike
```
Priya Infra: the control-plane deploy from earlier today included a change to latency-smoothing window (10s->2s). Could cause oscillation. rolling back is an option.
Tom Runtime: application-layer shows many sessions getting routed across region boundary causing KV cache misses and high tail. fallback to local variant reduces latency drastically in canary.
Morgan Support: immediate customer impact: 3 enterprise customers reported degraded performance for chat endpoints in APAC with timeouts. CS is sending hold messages.
Alice SRE: mitigation proposal: 1) pin routing for active sessions in EU to eu-primary for 30m, 2) rollback smoothing config on control-plane to previous value, 3) throttle policy re-evals to avoid flip-flopping. who can execute 1 and 2?
Priya Infra: I can revert the smoothing change. starting rollback now. ETA ~6m.
Raj Network: I can push a temporary pin rule that prioritizes region affinity for requests originating in EU. Pushing as a higher-priority policy so it overrides auto-steering. Doing that now.
Eli Oncall: assigning myself to coordinate mitigations and customer comms. Logging action items. will update every 10m.
IncidentBot: Action logged: rollback/smoothing-2026-03-15 by Priya Infra; region-pin-eu by Raj Network; oncall=Eli Oncall.
Alice SRE: quick sanity check after Raj’s pin: telemetry shows error rate dropping ~60% in last 30s. latency p95 improved from 2.3s -> 0.9s for EU-origin traffic.
Tom Runtime: confirm cache-hit ratio improved on the pinned path. CPU on APAC worker fleet back to baseline.
Priya Infra: rollback completed, control-plane smoothing window restored to 10s. no config drift detected. monitoring for stability.
Raj Network: pin rule deployed and propagated to routers. sample routing decision trace:
```
request_id=xyz987 src=eu-west-1 initial_route=apac-east final_route=eu-west-1 reason=pin-eu-override
```
Morgan Support: notifying affected customers that we applied mitigations and are monitoring. status page updated to "degraded service — partial mitigation in progress". sending targeted DM to enterprise contacts.
Eli Oncall: good. setting incident severity to Sev2->Sev3 as user impact reduced but not fully resolved. tagging incident for postmortem. can someone capture exact timeline of deploy->onset?
Alice SRE: timeline: control-plane deploy completed 17:12, first anomalies at 17:34, pager at 17:36, rollback started 17:43, rollback done 17:49, pin deployed 17:46, noticeable recovery by 17:48. I’ll paste into incident timeline doc afterwards.
Tom Runtime: note: there were a handful of long-lived connections that experienced a routing shift mid-KV-session; we should add session affinity check to routing policy tests.
Priya Infra: leaving a temp guard: rate-limit policy-eval triggers to 1/min for the next 2 hours. also pushing a dashboard alert for policy-eval frequency.
Raj Network: will run a sweep to confirm no stale pins remain after we lift them. suggest we lift pins in 60 min if stable.
Morgan Support: customers responded to update: appreciate the quick action, but want ETA on full resolution. suggested message: "We mitigated the immediate impact by applying region-affinity pins and rolling back a recent control-plane change. Engineers are monitoring; we expect full normalization within 1 hour." ok to send?
Eli Oncall: yes, send that. ensure support tag includes "follow-up postmortem" and we coordinate exec summary.
IncidentBot: Update: incident severity changed to Sev3 by Eli Oncall. Acknowledged actions: rollback, region-pin, eval-rate-limit.
Alice SRE: monitoring window 30m, so far steady. will hand off to next oncall at 18:50 UTC if stable. preparing postmortem draft outline: root cause hypothesis = aggressive latency-smoothing window combined with feedback loop in steering policy + lack of eval-rate throttling.
Tom Runtime: adding recommendation: add canary gate for smoothing config, add unit test for session-affinity across route changes.
Priya Infra: reminder: config change come with runbook step to coordinate with network for any steering-affecting flags.
Raj Network: once pins are lifted we should run a chaos probe that simulates cross-region latency to ensure no oscillation.
Eli Oncall: thanks all. excellent quick mitigation. handoff note: next oncall = Cassie at 18:50 UTC. leaving incident channel open. will publish postmortem with timeline and action items tomorrow.
Morgan Support: closing active customer DMs; customers asked for follow-up 1:1s. scheduling where needed.
IncidentBot: Incident closed for paging at 17:59 UTC — monitoring continues. Severity at close: Sev3.
